findings: learner.overview.text: Distinguish the numeral graph 亖 from 四: say that early forms written 亖 directly represented “four” and coexisted with forms written 四 (X-e6d62080b1a5fc5178a4). Identify the counting-rod account as an interpretation of some 四 forms, separate from the borrowing proposals (X-7b17032f87fb77433387). Also state distinctly that one proposal treats 四 as a breath-related graph associated with 呬, later borrowed for “four,” without establishing the depicted referent’s ancient name (X-2723cf5f9190c41c2cfe; X-4b62255296f832195814), while another proposes 四 was the original graph for 泗, depicting nasal discharge, later borrowed for “four”; the cited book says this proposal lacks textual attestation (X-e6d62080b1a5fc5178a4). Keep the present 囗-enclosing-儿-form description explicitly about visible structure, not ancient roles (X-741838c69c6335267eb0).
